Sandbox_KnoxWildlifeCoyote_Enabled: Coyotes: add them to the world
Sandbox_KnoxWildlifeCoyote_Enabled_toolt: Coyote: the widest ranging animal here, hunting edge and open ground and following the deer. Turn this off to leave coyotes out entirely: their routes are then not placed at all, and nothing else changes, because each species has its own target and none of them share a pool.
Sandbox_KnoxWildlifeCoyote_Routes_toolti: Multiplies this species' population, on top of Wildlife density. This is the setting that changes how many coyotes actually exist. Does nothing unless coyotes are turned on above.
Sandbox_KnoxWildlifeCoyote_GroupSize_too: Multiplies the size of each coyote group, on top of Group size. This does NOT change how many coyotes exist: the group count is divided to match, so you meet the same animals gathered into fewer, larger groups.
